text:
Predicates:
InfectiousDisease(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
Virus(x) ::: x is a virus.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x occurs in y.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
SymptomOf(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
Get(x, y) ::: x gets y.
Premises:
CausedBy(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ∧ InfectiousDisease(monkeypox) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, certainAnimals) ∧ ∀x (Human(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
∀x (Human(x) → Mammal(x)) ∧ ∀x (Mammal(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Humans are mammals. Mammals are animals.
SymptomOf(fever, monkeypox) ∧ SymptomOf(headache, monkeypox) ∧ SymptomOf(musclePains, monkeypox) ∧ SymptomOf(feelingTired, monkeypox) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
∀x (Get(x, flu) → Get(x, feelingTired)) ::: People feel tired when they get a flu.
Conclusion:
¬∃x Get(x, flu) ::: No one gets flu.
